same_physical_kernel: Target-first/increasing-block pooling, maximal A/KEEP reset, no B issuance; unchanged source model and unit B costs.
mathematical_extension: Permit arbitrary finite real H>0 and real balances within [0,H]. The local carry sum has an explicit finite descent with decrement delta=2H-(2a+b)+1 when positive. Thus the stationary output and weighted leak proof extend without rounding. If fresh input I<1, any packet longer than3H/(1-I) has a failed guard.
new_source_recipe: A finite number of profile stages determines integer p, a finite maximum burn-in determines integer q. Every source remains the unchanged complete original H_(p,q). Exact rational samples are arithmetic checks only; arbitrary-real validity comes from the symbolic and mathematical proof.
